blocks.text: Days 6–11 · Free days on the tropical coast of Búzios. A former fishing village about 170 km (105 miles) from Rio, Búzios has more than 20 magnificent beaches, crystal-clear water, beautiful landscapes, exotic vegetation and summer weather almost all year, with a unique combination of rustic charm, architectural harmony, sophisticated boutiques and restaurants that welcome travellers from all over the world. Try a different beach every day: the eastern beaches, on the Atlantic side, are windier and ideal for sports, while the western beaches offer calmer, warmer water for swimming and sunbathing.
Boats in a calm bay beside a sandy shore in Búzios, Brazil
